breakReminder.message: CHECKPOINT (3 machines on main): if you've finished something, commit + PUSH it now - don't save it all for end of day. Before starting a NEW area, PULL first. Stay ROOM-BY-ROOM (one person per file) to avoid conflicts. Guide: docs/process/TEAM-SYNC-DISCIPLINE.md

hooks.command: git fetch --all --prune 2>&1; echo ---; git pull --ff-only 2>&1; echo ---; git status 2>&1; echo ---; echo 'TEAM DISCIPLINE (3 machines on main): PULL before you touch a new area | work ROOM-BY-ROOM (one person per file) | commit+PUSH small & often | PULL again right before you push. Turn on VS Code git.autofetch to see the down-arrow when others push. Full guide: docs/process/TEAM-SYNC-DISCIPLINE.md'

dirty=$(git status --porcelain); ahead=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ -n "$dirty" ] || [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ]; then msg="LEAVE ritual - uncommitted or unpushed work here. Commit + PUSH before you step away, or the other machines (Laptop A / B / PC) can't see it. Then it's safe to leave. Discipline guide: docs/process/TEAM-SYNC-DISCIPLINE.md"; printf '{"systemMessage": "%s"}' "$msg"; fi
